title: acer keckianum
intro: Acer keckianum, commonly known as Keckiella cordifolia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae. This plant is primarily used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its ability to provide relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Acer keckianum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as protecting against cell damage and oxidative stress. The plant's therapeutic actions include its use as a diuretic and antiseptic, while its bioactive constituents include iridoid glycosides and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
